scripts.build: node scripts/write-build-meta.mjs && npm run seo:generate && npm run seo:verify && npm run assets:verify && vite build
scripts.pages:dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --compatibility-date=2026-09-02 --compatibility-flag=nodejs_compat
scripts.d1:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply obra-na-mao-comercial --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.d1:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply obra-na-mao-comercial --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.qa:prepare: node scripts/sync-artisys-qa.mjs && npm install --prefix qa/runtime --no-audit --no-fund && node qa/runtime/node_modules/playwright/cli.js install chromium
scripts.qa:quick: npm run qa:prepare && node scripts/run-artisys-qa.mjs quick
scripts.qa:full: npm run qa:prepare && node scripts/run-artisys-qa.mjs full
scripts.qa:release: npm run qa:prepare && npm test && npm run build && npm run ux:verify && npm run qa:p1 && node scripts/run-artisys-qa.mjs release
scripts.qa:p1:security: vitest run backend/p1-security.test.ts backend/loja-online-admin.test.ts src/owner-loja-online-contract.test.ts src/qa-p1-owner-hardening.test.ts src/qa-cross-system-contract.test.ts
scripts.qa:p1: npm run qa:p1:security && npm run qa:p1:matrix
